staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.primary: Phase III open-label randomized noninferiority; active cancer with acute proximal DVT/PE; 1,170 randomized, efficacy population 576 vs579. Apixaban 10 mg BID 7d then5 mg BID for6m vs dalteparin 200 IU/kg daily month1 then150 IU/kg months2–6. Recurrent VTE 5.6% vs7.9%, HR0.63 (95%CI0.37–1.07), P<.001 NI, P=.09 superiority. Major bleeding 3.8% vs4.0%, HR0.82 (0.40–1.69), P=.60; CRNMB9.0% vs6.0%.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.nnt: No NNT/NNH: noninferiority met, superiority not established; fixed 6-month event rates shown.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.remaining: Full supplement cancer-site bleeding, discontinuation and subgroup tables; QoL not reported in primary paper.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.status: primary efficacy and principal safety outcomes verified; still held

staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.primary: Phase III double-blind noninferiority; 1,766 active-cancer patients with proximal DVT/PE after ≥6m anticoagulation; apixaban2.5mg BID vs5mg BID for12m. Recurrent VTE 2.1% vs2.8%, adjusted sub-HR0.76 (95%CI0.41–1.41), P=.001 NI; clinically relevant bleeding12.1% vs15.6%, sub-HR0.75 (0.58–0.97), P=.03; median treatment11.8m.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.nnt: NNT29 only for 12m secondary clinically relevant bleeding: 15.6−12.1=3.5pp; ceil(100/3.5)=29. No NNT for primary VTE noninferiority.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.remaining: Full grade3–5 safety, adherence/discontinuation, subgroup and supplementary tables; QoL not reported in primary paper.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.status: primary efficacy and key bleeding outcomes verified; still held

staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.primary: Phase III double-blind; 461 resectable stage IIA–IIIB NSCLC, ECOG0–1, EGFR/ALK-negative. Nivolumab360mg q3w+platinum doublet x4, surgery within6w, nivolumab480mg q4w for1y vs placebo+same chemo/surgery/placebo. Median follow-up25.4m; 18m EFS70.2% vs50.0%, HR0.58 (97.36%CI0.42–0.81), P<.001; pCR25.3% vs4.7%; MPR35.4% vs12.1%; grade3–4 TRAE32.5% vs25.2%.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.remaining: Platinum-doublet distribution, full AE/discontinuation appendix, PRO domain estimates and mature OS; disease-related symptom outcomes favor perioperative nivolumab.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.status: primary design, efficacy and key safety outcomes verified; still held

staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.primary: Phase III open-label; 423 resectable macroscopic stage III melanoma. Two neoadjuvant cycles ipilimumab1mg/kg+nivolumab3mg/kg q3w, surgery, response-adapted adjuvant vs surgery then nivolumab480mg q4w up to12 cycles. Median follow-up9.9m; 12m EFS83.7% vs57.2%, HR0.32 (99.9%CI0.15–0.66); RMST difference8.0m (99.9%CI4.94–11.05), P<.001; grade≥3 systemic-treatment AEs29.7% vs14.7%.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.remaining: Response-adapted adjuvant/BRAF details, surgery/perioperative complications, full safety tables and long-term EFS/OS. No QoL endpoint identified in primary paper. Accessible NCCN Melanoma Insights v2.2024 predates report and does not cite NADINA.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.status: primary efficacy and grade≥3 safety verified; still held

staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.primary: Phase II open-label; 313 resectable stage IIIB–IVC melanoma (154 vs159). Pembrolizumab200mg q3w x3 neoadjuvant, surgery, then15 adjuvant vs surgery then18 doses. Median follow-up14.7m; 2y EFS72% (95%CI64–80) vs49% (41–59), P=.004; grade≥3 TRAE12% vs14%.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.remaining: Full surgery timing/exposure, subgroup estimates and longer-term EFS/OS. No QoL endpoint identified in primary paper. NCCN Melanoma Insights v2.2024 ref29 exact; 2026 freshness open.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.status: primary efficacy and grade≥3 safety verified; still held

staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.primary: Phase III double-blind; advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer, dMMR n215 (109 vs106), pMMR n550 (276 vs274). Pembrolizumab200mg q3w+paclitaxel175mg/m²+carboplatin AUC5 x6 then pembrolizumab400mg q6w up to14 maintenance vs placebo. dMMR 12m PFS74% vs38%, HR0.30 (95%CI0.19–0.48); pMMR median PFS13.1 vs8.7m, HR0.54 (0.41–0.71); both P<.001. Grade≥3 AEs dMMR63.3% vs47.2%, pMMR55.1% vs45.3%; grade5 1 vs2 dMMR,6 vs2 pMMR.
staged_trial_primary_source_reviews.nnt: NNT3 only for 12m dMMR PFS: 36pp; ceil(100/36)=3. No pooled NNT.
